proposals: NSE Indices and BSE should publish official rolling 10- and 20-year CAGR tables for the Nifty 50 and Sensex, in price-return and total-return form, updated monthly, so savers comparing equity with PPF and EPF use the index owners’ numbers rather than varying secondary aggregations.

SEBI should maintain a public, named list of unlisted-share platforms it has found operating without authorisation, alongside its advisories, so a fourth advisory after those of 2016, 2024 and 2026 can point investors to specific entities rather than a general warning.

The Ministry of Finance should publish, with each quarterly small-savings notification, the benchmark yields used and the rate the formula would have produced for PPF, so more than six years of unchanged 7.1% decisions can be read against the reference rate each quarter.

The Ministry of Finance should publish the cost comparison behind the 2025 decision to stop new Sovereign Gold Bond issues, and the conditions under which issuance would resume, so savers know whether the discontinuation is permanent or conditional.

AMFI should publish a standard 10- and 20-year domestic gold price return series from one declared benchmark, alongside its fund-category data, so gold’s long-run return is not an approximate band that varies across market-data sources.
